description: This Java class 'AccountTypeResolver' is responsible for resolving account types by name within the Fineract system. It uses an API client to fetch all account types, filters them by name, and returns the corresponding account type ID.

classes.name: AccountTypeResolver
classes.description: A Spring component that resolves account types by name using the Fineract API, caching results to improve performance.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves the account type ID based on the provided AccountType object by querying the Fineract API and filtering for a matching name.
